content.text:
A股景气投资体系 V2.1（完整版）

状态：唯一有效版本（Canonical）
生效日期：2026-07-20
默认研究周期：未来12—18个月；产业趋势必要时延伸至3年
替代范围：V2.1替代V2.0及此前所有“景气40%+位置35%+弹性25%”“行业20%+纯度40%+估值25%+龙头15%”“市场辨识度加20分”、仅以相关业务收入占比定义纯度，以及其他实验性景气评分口径，均视为废止。

0. 唯一默认规则（记忆索引）

用户是A股景气投资者。后续凡提到“我的景气投资体系”“按原体系分析”“景气评分”“景气度、位置和弹性排序”，必须默认调用本文件的V2.1完整版，不得回退到旧口径。

核心公式：

[
综合分=40%\times G+20%\times R+25%\times B+15%\times T-风险处罚
]

G：景气与公司承接度——决定是否进入核心股票池。

R：赔率与预期差——决定当前价格还剩多少空间。

B：经营、估值和交易弹性——决定判断正确后的收益斜率。

T：产业催化与市场时点——决定何时介入和验证。

风险处罚/硬否决——避免高弹性掩盖治理、现金流和资本开支问题。

核心哲学：

景气决定买什么，预期差决定赔率，经营杠杆决定弹性，产业证据与市场定价的阶段差决定时点。

0.1 V2.1新增的强制规则

V2.1在完整保留V2.0的G/R/B/T、有效景气纯度、E/M双阶段及风险处罚框架基础上，新增远期期权模块：

利润与估值分离：远期项目暂不进入2027—2028年基础利润，不代表其估值为零。

双概率分离：必须分别估计“目标年份形成利润的概率”(P_{i,t})与“最终实现商业化的概率”(P_{i,\infty})。

阶段与路径分离：项目E阶段相同，不代表变现时间和成功率相同；必须同时标注L1/L2/L3变现路径。

时间价值：远期期权按距离商业化的年限、剩余资本开支、融资摊薄和风险折现，不得只用成熟价值乘单一成功概率。

P2分层：P2拆为P2a近期期权合理价值和P2b远期期权合理价值。

基本面与抢跑分离：基本面概率加权价值属于P2；A股因题材扩散、板块共振和业务属性切换产生的提前定价属于P3，不得混入净利润预测。

三种利润口径：每次预测必须同时给出报表情景利润、概率加权期望利润和全部顺利时的乐观上限。

1. 体系适用边界

1.1 主要适用

需求扩张型主线：AI算力、先进封装、存储、半导体设备材料、创新药出海等。

供给约束型周期：制冷剂、资源品、化工品、航运、部分存储产品等。

新业务重估：传统主业提供业绩锚，新产品可能改变利润中枢或估值属性。

底部反转：价格、库存、开工率、利用率和毛利率开始右侧改善。

政策驱动但能够被订单、招标、出货或收入验证的方向。

1.2 不定义为核心景气投资

只有概念映射、没有可量化产业指标的纯题材。

行业需求没有改善，仅因股价低或估值低而推荐。

依赖单次资产出售、补贴或非经常损益的利润增长。

产业仍在供给无序扩张、公司缺乏成本或技术优势的伪反转。

G分低于60的标的；此类即使交易属性强，也只能归为事件交易。

2. 研究前置：全景扫描

分析公司前，必须扫描全部重要业务、产品、项目、子公司、参股、海外平台和资本运作，不得只研究当期最热门题材。

2.1 必扫内容

现有主营：收入、毛利润、净利润、毛利率、客户、下游、份额、产能、利用率。

新成长：新产品、新客户、新订单、新产能、新技术、国产替代、出海、AI、高端制造、政策映射。

资本结构：并表子公司、联营企业、参股上市公司、产业基金、并购资产、潜在分拆或上市平台。

财务基本盘：近3年营收、毛利率、净利率、扣非净利、经营现金流、资本开支、净负债；最新季度变化。

产业数据：价格、订单、招标、排产、库存、进出口、客户验证、资本开支、同行业财报。

最近30—90天：重大政策、配额、技术突破、客户认证、科技奖励、环评、投产、融资与股东行为。

2.2 固定四层来源

监管及官方统计：部委、交易所、海关、统计局、招标平台、环评、配额和注册信息。

产业协会与数据库：协会、价格数据库、排产、库存、设备装机、进出口和行业资本开支。

公司披露：年报、季报、公告、投资者交流、招股书、环评、募投和子公司信息。

科研与客户侧：高校院所、重大科技奖励、客户认证、客户公告、供应链交叉验证。

证据优先级：监管/客户/财报（A级）>协会/数据库/正式投产（B级）>券商调研和多源供应链（C级）>媒体传闻和互动平台模糊表述（D级）。

3. 四层业务价值

类型

定义

估值作用

业绩锚

已贡献稳定收入、利润和现金流

决定逻辑失败后的估值下限

修复锚

价格、毛利率、开工率、利用率或亏损业务正在恢复

决定阶段性盈利上修

订单期权

已送样、认证、小批量、复购、forecast、招标或订单

决定中期估值扩张

题材期权

产业空间存在，但订单和收入证据较弱

决定远期和情绪弹性

订单期权与题材期权还必须按变现时间拆分：

近期期权：未来12—24个月有较大概率形成收入、利润或现金流，进入P2a。

远期期权：近期利润贡献有限，但最终商业化具有合理概率并可能改变利润中枢或业务属性，进入P2b。

项目属于远期期权，不等于题材价值为零；项目属于订单期权，也不等于可以100%计入下一年利润。

3.1 防重复计分

已进入未来利润预测的新业务，不得再次完整加入SOTP。

同一客户、同一技术、同一需求来源的多个项目必须考虑相关性，不能按独立概率相加。

规划产能不能直接按达产利润计算。

参股公司价值必须乘持股比例，并考虑不并表、锁定期、少数股东、流动性和估值波动。

产业链内部自供业务主要体现成本和供应安全，不应同时按外售收入和主业利润重复计值。

已按目标年份概率加权计入期望利润的部分，在SOTP中只能计入该利润对应价值；剩余尚未进入目标年份利润的远期价值方可作为独立期权，防止利润法与期权法重复计值。

同一项目的E阶段概率、技术成功概率、客户认证概率不得无条件重复相乘；必须先判断它们是否已经互相包含，优先使用条件情景树。

4. G：景气与公司承接度（综合权重40%）

4.1 G内部评分

子项

权重

核心问题

需求强度及增速

15

需求是否真实增长、加速或超预期

供给约束及竞争格局

10

供给能否自由扩张、份额是否集中、是否有配额/认证/资源壁垒

景气持续时间

15

是一季事件、1—2年趋势还是3年以上产业浪潮

产业周期位置

10

底部左侧、右侧修复、加速上行、高位景气或高位退潮

公司景气承接度

25

公司当前及未来利润能否真正承接全部高景气方向

业绩、订单及现金流验证

15

订单、收入、利润、毛利率和现金流是否同向

多源数据可信度

10

是否有监管、行业、公司和客户/科研多源交叉验证

合计

100



4.2 G分级与硬门槛

G分数

定位

80—100

核心高景气方向

70—79

高景气候选

60—69

局部景气、周期修复或验证不足

低于60

不进入景气核心池

5. 修正后的纯度：景气加权纯度

5.1 废止定义

废止“单一热门业务收入占比越高，公司纯度越高”的定义。多元化本身不扣分；多个高景气业务可以构成平台型高纯度。

5.2 新定义

公司景气承接度，是公司当前利润和未来增量利润对所有高景气业务的综合暴露程度。

对每项业务 (j) 评估：赛道景气度 (g_j)、公司受益系数 (c_j)、收入占比、当前利润占比、未来增量利润占比。

[
收入景气暴露=\sum_j 收入占比_j\times g_j\times c_j
]

[
利润景气暴露=\sum_j 利润占比_j\times g_j\times c_j
]

[
增量景气暴露=\sum_j 未来增量利润占比_j\times g_j\times c_j
]

[
有效景气纯度=20%\times收入景气暴露+40%\times利润景气暴露+40%\times增量景气暴露+协同加分-低回报拖累
]

5.3 不同业务的处理

业务类型

处理原则

同一高景气赛道

正向计分

另一个真实高景气赛道

同样正向计分，不因多元化扣分

共享原料、技术、客户、渠道的一体化业务

给予产业协同和胜率加分

稳定现金牛

不增加景气度，但提高业绩锚和下限

周期底部业务

计入修复锚，按修复概率计分

长期亏损、持续消耗资本的业务

扣除低回报拖累

只有概念映射的业务

不能提高当前利润纯度，只计题材期权

5.4 单赛道纯度与平台纯度

三美股份式公司：单赛道利润高度集中，属于单赛道高纯度，优势是利润弹性直接。

巨化股份式公司：制冷剂、高端含氟材料、HFO、半导体材料等多项高景气业务叠加，属于平台型高景气纯度，优势是景气持续性和估值上限。

二者不能仅按制冷剂收入占比高低判定谁“更纯”；必须比较当前高景气利润、未来增量利润和低回报业务拖累。

5.5 远期期权对纯度的处理

有效景气纯度中的“未来增量利润占比”不得只按未来12—18个月会计利润计算，也不能把所有远期成熟利润100%计入。必须拆为：

近期期望增量利润暴露
+
远期期权景气暴露
]

近期期望增量利润暴露：使用目标年份兑现概率(P_{i,t})加权，主要影响未来1—3年业绩预测。

远期期权景气暴露：使用最终商业化概率(P_{i,\infty})、路径长度、产业协同和成熟价值加权，主要影响业务属性、估值上限和平台纯度。

只有技术名称或概念映射、缺少项目主体、资源投入和技术协同的远期期权，不提高有效纯度。

与现有原料、工艺、客户、渠道高度协同的远期项目，即使近期利润为零，也可以提高公司未来景气承接度；但必须通过较低概率和时间折现限制计值。

6. R：赔率与预期差（综合权重20%）

子项

权重

当前市值隐含成功率

30

主业下行保护

20

尚未计价的P2a近期期权

20

尚未计价的P2b远期期权及业务属性重估

10

历史及同业估值

10

中性上涨空间/证伪下跌空间

10

合计

100

6.1 四层估值

[
目标市值=V_{业绩锚}+V_{修复锚}+V_{订单期权}+V_{题材期权}-V_{风险}
]

稳定业务用未来利润或正常化利润乘合理PE；重资产结合EV/EBITDA、PB或重置成本；参股平台使用折价SOTP。

订单/题材期权：

[
V_i=成熟价值_i\times成功概率_i\times持股比例\times质量系数-未投入资本
]

上式只作为最简筛选式。正式估值必须使用V2.1远期期权公式：

\sum_s
\frac{
P_{i,\infty,s}\times V_{成熟,i,s}\times Q_{i,s}\times 持股比例_i
}{
(1+r_i)^{T_{i,s}}
}
-PV(剩余资本开支、融资成本与潜在摊薄)
]

其中：

(P_{i,\infty,s})：情景(s)下项目最终实现商业化并形成正经济利润的概率。

(V_{成熟,i,s})：成熟产能、合理利用率和正常价格下的可持续股权价值，而不是峰值收入或峰值利润。

(Q_{i,s})：利润质量系数，考虑壁垒、现金流、客户集中、价格持续性和资本回报率。

(T_{i,s})：距离商业化成熟的年限，而非距离“宣布投产”的年限。

(r_i)：风险折现率；技术、认证、融资、政策和竞争不确定性越高，折现率越高。

防止重复折价：项目失败风险原则上进入(P_{i,\infty})，纯时间价值和股权回报要求进入(r_i)，利润质量进入(Q_i)。同一技术或认证风险不能同时大幅压低成功概率、提高折现率并再次降低质量系数。若成熟价值已经按届时净债务计算，剩余资本开支和融资也不得重复扣除。

不得以一个统一成功概率覆盖全部项目。必须同时区分：

[
P_{i,t}=项目i在目标年份t形成实质利润的概率
]

[
P_{i,\infty}=项目i最终实现商业化并形成正经济利润的概率
]

通常有(P_{i,t}\le P_{i,\infty})。一个项目2027年利润兑现概率可能只有10%，最终商业化概率仍可能达到60%；此时它不应大额进入2027年净利润，但仍可贡献经时间折现后的P2b远期期权价值。

6.2 近期期权与远期期权

类型

判断标准

利润处理

估值处理

P2a近期期权

未来12—24个月可能形成实质利润

按(P_{i,t})进入期望利润；在对应情景中按真实爬坡计入

使用目标年份利润或近两年SOTP

P2b远期期权

近期利润较少，但长期商业化概率和成熟价值不可忽略

不进入基础利润；只进入对应乐观情景或小额期望利润

按(P_{i,\infty})、时间和剩余投入折现计值

6.3 A股提前定价与基本面价值分离

[
P2价值=V_{业绩锚}+V_{修复锚}+V_{P2a}+V_{P2b}-V_{风险}
]

P2是基本面概率加权合理价值。P3是在P2基础上，市场因行业主线、题材扩散、业务属性切换、筹码和流动性产生的交易区间。市场可以在利润兑现前交易最终成功概率，但分析必须分别输出：

基本面期权合理价值；

当前市值已计入的期权价值；

市场隐含的最终成功概率；

P3相对P2的抢跑溢价；

若M阶段退潮而E阶段不变，股价可能回归的P2或P1区间。

不能因为A股会提前计价就把P3直接定义为基本面合理价值；也不能因为项目近期没有利润就把P2b计为零。

6.4 反向估值

[
已定价期权=当前市值-业绩锚价值-修复锚价值-独立资产价值
]

[
市场隐含成功率=\frac{已定价期权}{全部期权成熟价值}
]

对单个远期项目，正式反推式为：

\frac{
市场分配给项目i的已定价价值\times(1+r_i)^{T_i}
}{
V_{成熟,i}\times Q_i\times持股比例_i
}
]

剩余资本开支、融资和摊薄应先从市场已定价价值或成熟价值中按统一口径调整，再反推概率。

若公司同时拥有多个不同路径的期权，不能用“全部期权成熟价值”简单汇总。应分别反推各项目隐含成功率，或先按研究判断的相对权重分配市场已定价期权，避免高成熟价值、低概率的远期项目扭曲整体结果。

[
预期差=研究判断成功率-市场隐含成功率
]

产业方向正确不等于股票有赔率。研究成功率显著高于市场隐含成功率才构成可投资预期差。

7. B：弹性（综合权重25%）

子项

权重

产品价格、销量、利用率对净利润的敏感性

35

新业务潜在增量利润规模

25

业务属性及估值切换空间

20

市值、自由流通盘及筹码结构

15

市场辨识度和传播能力

5

合计

100

必须分别输出：

经营弹性：价格/销量/利用率每变化1个单位，利润变化多少。

估值弹性：从传统周期/制造向成长平台切换时，合理估值中枢变化多少。

交易弹性：市值、流通盘、筹码和市场注意力决定的股价斜率。

市场辨识度只占5%，防止体系退化为追逐热门股。

8. T：时点（综合权重15%）

子项

权重

高频产业指标改善

25

10.5 单项目利润模型

对项目(i)、年份(t)、情景(s)：

\left[
产能_i\times\frac{投产月份_{i,t,s}}{12}\times利用率_{i,t,s}\times良率_{i,t,s}
\times(单价_{i,t,s}-单位变动成本_{i,t,s})
-固定费用-折旧-财务费用
\right]
\times(1-税率)\times归属权益比例
]

延期导致的实际投产月份减少；

初期低良率、低利用率和客户爬坡；

投产后亏损情景，而非只设“成功盈利”和“失败为零”；

新增折旧、费用、营运资本、利息、少数股东权益；

12. 主升浪判定

真正主升浪至少满足四项：

行业高频数据继续强化，而非只靠远期故事。

公司订单、价格、收入或毛利率进入上修周期。

机构盈利预测连续上调，且上调幅度能够覆盖估值扩张。

板块宽度和龙头共振，股价突破后有承接而非单日情绪脉冲。

主升浪不是必买信号。如果M阶段显著领先E阶段，应优先评估透支而非追涨。

13. 风险处罚与硬否决

13.1 普通风险（总分扣0—10）

资本开支过重、自由现金流弱。

利润增长但经营现金流、应收、库存恶化。

低回报传统业务持续扩张。

客户、订单和收入确认不透明。

股东减持、质押、再融资和摊薄。

项目延期、良率或利用率低于预期。

行业供给快速扩张，产品价格下跌。

市场隐含成功率过高、成交拥挤、利好钝化。

13.2 硬否决

审计非标、重大财务真实性问题。

严重关联交易、资金占用或治理问题。

重大安全、环保、政策或合规风险。

新业务完全依赖融资，且没有真实产业证据。

核心景气逻辑已经证伪，只能依赖题材维持股价。

14. 评分和排序规则

14.1 综合分

[
综合分=0.40G+0.20R+0.25B+0.15T-风险处罚
]

14.2 景气门槛优先于总分

G≥80：可进入核心高景气池，再比较R/B/T。

70≤G<80：高景气候选，等待验证或更好赔率。

60≤G<70：修复或局部景气，只能降低配置等级。

G<60：不能因B和T高而进入核心景气池。

14.3 必须同时输出四个结论

胜率：主要由G、治理执行和证据质量决定。

赔率：主要由R、P0/P2距离和隐含成功率决定。

弹性：由B决定，不等同于胜率。

时点：由T和E/M阶段差决定。

禁止仅凭一个综合分掩盖“高胜率低赔率”或“低胜率高弹性”。

15. 标准研究输出模板

结论先行：是否高景气、是否核心受益、当前E/M阶段、胜率/赔率/弹性/时点、一句话逻辑、核心矛盾。

全景扫描：所有主营、新业务、产能、客户、子公司、参股、海外和资本运作。

四层分类：业绩锚、修复锚、订单期权、题材期权。

分赛道景气：需求、供给、持续时间、验证指标、周期位置。

景气承接度：收入、利润、增量利润的景气暴露及低回报拖累。

业绩测算：保守/中性/乐观未来1—3年净利润，并同时给出核心业务利润、高确定性项目利润、期权加权利润、概率加权总利润和乐观上限。

期权估值：逐项目列出E阶段、L路径、目标年份兑现概率(P_{i,t})、最终成功概率(P_{i,\infty})、成熟价值、变现年限、剩余投入、基本面期权价值、已定价价值和市场隐含成功率。

市场预期：当前股价交易题材、订单、业绩、周期反转、估值切换还是资产重估。

G/R/B/T评分：列出子项和证据，避免只给主观总分。

P0—P4股价区间：明确P2a近期期权、P2b远期期权、P3抢跑溢价及各区间所需假设。

催化与证伪：未来30—90天、1年、2年节点。

最终排序：景气度、赔率、弹性、时点分别排序，再给综合排序。

16. 体系维护和回测

每次财报、重大订单、价格拐点、配额变化或项目升阶后更新E阶段、盈利模型和市场隐含概率。

保存当时可获得的信息，避免用未来结果倒推过去评分。

检验未来3、6、12个月超额收益、最大回撤、胜率和盈亏比。

分别回测需求扩张、供给约束、新业务重估、底部反转和政策主题，不能假设所有类型使用同一概率和估值。

权重若调整，必须形成新版本号并说明变更；V2.1在新版本正式确认前始终是唯一默认版本。

最终约束摘要

景气是必要条件，不用低估值替代景气。

纯度是全部高景气利润暴露，不是单一业务收入占比。

多个真实高景气业务不会因多元化扣分。

低回报业务只通过利润拖累、资本占用和现金流扣分。

不等利润全部兑现，但必须等待最小可验证信号。

产业E阶段与市场M阶段必须分开。

当前股价必须反向计算隐含成功率。

题材和远期期权可以在利润兑现前进入A股股价，但必须区分目标年份兑现概率与最终成功概率，不能100%计值。

远期期权不进入近期基础利润不代表价值为零；必须按路径长度、成熟价值、最终成功概率、时间和剩余投入计入P2b。

A股对远期期权的提前定价属于P3，必须与P2基本面期权价值分开，并反推市场隐含成功率。

价格行为只判断时点，不证明产业逻辑。

所有分析最终输出胜率、赔率、弹性、时点和P0—P4价格层级。

核心公式：

[
综合分=40%\times G+20%\times R+25%\times B+15%\times T-风险处罚
]

G：景气与公司承接度——决定是否进入核心股票池。

R：赔率与预期差——决定当前价格还剩多少空间。

B：经营、估值和交易弹性——决定判断正确后的收益斜率。

T：产业催化与市场时点——决定何时介入和验证。

风险处罚/硬否决——避免高弹性掩盖治理、现金流和资本开支问题。

核心哲学：

景气决定买什么，预期差决定赔率，经营杠杆决定弹性，产业证据与市场定价的阶段差决定时点。

0.1 V2.1新增的强制规则

V2.1在完整保留V2.0的G/R/B/T、有效景气纯度、E/M双阶段及风险处罚框架基础上，新增远期期权模块：

利润与估值分离：远期项目暂不进入2027—2028年基础利润，不代表其估值为零。

双概率分离：必须分别估计“目标年份形成利润的概率”(P_{i,t})与“最终实现商业化的概率”(P_{i,\infty})。

阶段与路径分离：项目E阶段相同，不代表变现时间和成功率相同；必须同时标注L1/L2/L3变现路径。

时间价值：远期期权按距离商业化的年限、剩余资本开支、融资摊薄和风险折现，不得只用成熟价值乘单一成功概率。

P2分层：P2拆为P2a近期期权合理价值和P2b远期期权合理价值。

基本面与抢跑分离：基本面概率加权价值属于P2；A股因题材扩散、板块共振和业务属性切换产生的提前定价属于P3，不得混入净利润预测。

三种利润口径：每次预测必须同时给出报表情景利润、概率加权期望利润和全部顺利时的乐观上限。

1. 体系适用边界

1.1 主要适用

需求扩张型主线：AI算力、先进封装、存储、半导体设备材料、创新药出海等。

供给约束型周期：制冷剂、资源品、化工品、航运、部分存储产品等。

新业务重估：传统主业提供业绩锚，新产品可能改变利润中枢或估值属性。

底部反转：价格、库存、开工率、利用率和毛利率开始右侧改善。

政策驱动但能够被订单、招标、出货或收入验证的方向。

1.2 不定义为核心景气投资

只有概念映射、没有可量化产业指标的纯题材。

行业需求没有改善，仅因股价低或估值低而推荐。

依赖单次资产出售、补贴或非经常损益的利润增长。

产业仍在供给无序扩张、公司缺乏成本或技术优势的伪反转。

G分低于60的标的；此类即使交易属性强，也只能归为事件交易。

2. 研究前置：全景扫描

分析公司前，必须扫描全部重要业务、产品、项目、子公司、参股、海外平台和资本运作，不得只研究当期最热门题材。

2.1 必扫内容

现有主营：收入、毛利润、净利润、毛利率、客户、下游、份额、产能、利用率。

新成长：新产品、新客户、新订单、新产能、新技术、国产替代、出海、AI、高端制造、政策映射。

资本结构：并表子公司、联营企业、参股上市公司、产业基金、并购资产、潜在分拆或上市平台。

财务基本盘：近3年营收、毛利率、净利率、扣非净利、经营现金流、资本开支、净负债；最新季度变化。

产业数据：价格、订单、招标、排产、库存、进出口、客户验证、资本开支、同行业财报。

最近30—90天：重大政策、配额、技术突破、客户认证、科技奖励、环评、投产、融资与股东行为。

2.2 固定四层来源

监管及官方统计：部委、交易所、海关、统计局、招标平台、环评、配额和注册信息。

产业协会与数据库：协会、价格数据库、排产、库存、设备装机、进出口和行业资本开支。

公司披露：年报、季报、公告、投资者交流、招股书、环评、募投和子公司信息。

科研与客户侧：高校院所、重大科技奖励、客户认证、客户公告、供应链交叉验证。

证据优先级：监管/客户/财报（A级）>协会/数据库/正式投产（B级）>券商调研和多源供应链（C级）>媒体传闻和互动平台模糊表述（D级）。

3.1 防重复计分

已进入未来利润预测的新业务，不得再次完整加入SOTP。

同一客户、同一技术、同一需求来源的多个项目必须考虑相关性，不能按独立概率相加。

规划产能不能直接按达产利润计算。

参股公司价值必须乘持股比例，并考虑不并表、锁定期、少数股东、流动性和估值波动。

产业链内部自供业务主要体现成本和供应安全，不应同时按外售收入和主业利润重复计值。

已按目标年份概率加权计入期望利润的部分，在SOTP中只能计入该利润对应价值；剩余尚未进入目标年份利润的远期价值方可作为独立期权，防止利润法与期权法重复计值。

同一项目的E阶段概率、技术成功概率、客户认证概率不得无条件重复相乘；必须先判断它们是否已经互相包含，优先使用条件情景树。

5. 修正后的纯度：景气加权纯度

5.1 废止定义

废止“单一热门业务收入占比越高，公司纯度越高”的定义。多元化本身不扣分；多个高景气业务可以构成平台型高纯度。

5.2 新定义

公司景气承接度，是公司当前利润和未来增量利润对所有高景气业务的综合暴露程度。

对每项业务 (j) 评估：赛道景气度 (g_j)、公司受益系数 (c_j)、收入占比、当前利润占比、未来增量利润占比。

[
收入景气暴露=\sum_j 收入占比_j\times g_j\times c_j
]

[
利润景气暴露=\sum_j 利润占比_j\times g_j\times c_j
]

[
增量景气暴露=\sum_j 未来增量利润占比_j\times g_j\times c_j
]

[
有效景气纯度=20%\times收入景气暴露+40%\times利润景气暴露+40%\times增量景气暴露+协同加分-低回报拖累
]

5.4 单赛道纯度与平台纯度

三美股份式公司：单赛道利润高度集中，属于单赛道高纯度，优势是利润弹性直接。

巨化股份式公司：制冷剂、高端含氟材料、HFO、半导体材料等多项高景气业务叠加，属于平台型高景气纯度，优势是景气持续性和估值上限。

二者不能仅按制冷剂收入占比高低判定谁“更纯”；必须比较当前高景气利润、未来增量利润和低回报业务拖累。

5.5 远期期权对纯度的处理

有效景气纯度中的“未来增量利润占比”不得只按未来12—18个月会计利润计算，也不能把所有远期成熟利润100%计入。必须拆为：

近期期望增量利润暴露
+
远期期权景气暴露
]

近期期望增量利润暴露：使用目标年份兑现概率(P_{i,t})加权，主要影响未来1—3年业绩预测。

远期期权景气暴露：使用最终商业化概率(P_{i,\infty})、路径长度、产业协同和成熟价值加权，主要影响业务属性、估值上限和平台纯度。

只有技术名称或概念映射、缺少项目主体、资源投入和技术协同的远期期权，不提高有效纯度。

与现有原料、工艺、客户、渠道高度协同的远期项目，即使近期利润为零，也可以提高公司未来景气承接度；但必须通过较低概率和时间折现限制计值。

6.1 四层估值

[
目标市值=V_{业绩锚}+V_{修复锚}+V_{订单期权}+V_{题材期权}-V_{风险}
]

稳定业务用未来利润或正常化利润乘合理PE；重资产结合EV/EBITDA、PB或重置成本；参股平台使用折价SOTP。

订单/题材期权：

[
V_i=成熟价值_i\times成功概率_i\times持股比例\times质量系数-未投入资本
]

上式只作为最简筛选式。正式估值必须使用V2.1远期期权公式：

\sum_s
\frac{
P_{i,\infty,s}\times V_{成熟,i,s}\times Q_{i,s}\times 持股比例_i
}{
(1+r_i)^{T_{i,s}}
}
-PV(剩余资本开支、融资成本与潜在摊薄)
]

其中：

(P_{i,\infty,s})：情景(s)下项目最终实现商业化并形成正经济利润的概率。

(V_{成熟,i,s})：成熟产能、合理利用率和正常价格下的可持续股权价值，而不是峰值收入或峰值利润。

(Q_{i,s})：利润质量系数，考虑壁垒、现金流、客户集中、价格持续性和资本回报率。

(T_{i,s})：距离商业化成熟的年限，而非距离“宣布投产”的年限。

(r_i)：风险折现率；技术、认证、融资、政策和竞争不确定性越高，折现率越高。

防止重复折价：项目失败风险原则上进入(P_{i,\infty})，纯时间价值和股权回报要求进入(r_i)，利润质量进入(Q_i)。同一技术或认证风险不能同时大幅压低成功概率、提高折现率并再次降低质量系数。若成熟价值已经按届时净债务计算，剩余资本开支和融资也不得重复扣除。

不得以一个统一成功概率覆盖全部项目。必须同时区分：

[
P_{i,t}=项目i在目标年份t形成实质利润的概率
]

[
P_{i,\infty}=项目i最终实现商业化并形成正经济利润的概率
]

通常有(P_{i,t}\le P_{i,\infty})。一个项目2027年利润兑现概率可能只有10%，最终商业化概率仍可能达到60%；此时它不应大额进入2027年净利润，但仍可贡献经时间折现后的P2b远期期权价值。

6.3 A股提前定价与基本面价值分离

[
P2价值=V_{业绩锚}+V_{修复锚}+V_{P2a}+V_{P2b}-V_{风险}
]

P2是基本面概率加权合理价值。P3是在P2基础上，市场因行业主线、题材扩散、业务属性切换、筹码和流动性产生的交易区间。市场可以在利润兑现前交易最终成功概率，但分析必须分别输出：

基本面期权合理价值；

当前市值已计入的期权价值；

市场隐含的最终成功概率；

P3相对P2的抢跑溢价；

若M阶段退潮而E阶段不变，股价可能回归的P2或P1区间。

不能因为A股会提前计价就把P3直接定义为基本面合理价值；也不能因为项目近期没有利润就把P2b计为零。

6.4 反向估值

[
已定价期权=当前市值-业绩锚价值-修复锚价值-独立资产价值
]

[
市场隐含成功率=\frac{已定价期权}{全部期权成熟价值}
]

对单个远期项目，正式反推式为：

\frac{
市场分配给项目i的已定价价值\times(1+r_i)^{T_i}
}{
V_{成熟,i}\times Q_i\times持股比例_i
}
]

剩余资本开支、融资和摊薄应先从市场已定价价值或成熟价值中按统一口径调整，再反推概率。

若公司同时拥有多个不同路径的期权，不能用“全部期权成熟价值”简单汇总。应分别反推各项目隐含成功率，或先按研究判断的相对权重分配市场已定价期权，避免高成熟价值、低概率的远期项目扭曲整体结果。

[
预期差=研究判断成功率-市场隐含成功率
]

产业方向正确不等于股票有赔率。研究成功率显著高于市场隐含成功率才构成可投资预期差。

30%—55%

E4放量验证

复购、forecast、扩产、利用率提升

55%—80%

E5稳定兑现

稳定收入、利润和现金流

80%—100%

表中概率只是同类项目最终成功概率的初始先验，不是目标年份利润兑现概率。必须根据行业供需、公司壁垒、客户集中度、资本开支、竞争者扩产和变现路径调整。

9.2 变现路径阶段L

E阶段回答“已有多少证据”，L阶段回答“从当前证据到形成收入和利润还需要跨越多少环节”。两者必须组合使用。

路径

典型特征

从当前节点到收入/利润的常见时间

主要风险

处理原则

L1短路径

现有产线技改、成熟产品扩产、现有客户追加订单、已具备供应资格

3—9个月

施工、产能利用率、价格

E2—E3后可部分进入下一年中性利润

L2中路径

新建产线、工艺较成熟但需新客户认证或海外导入

9—24个月

建设、良率、认证、订单爬坡

未试产/认证前主要进入P2a或P2b，不得按满产利润计入

L3长路径

新技术路线、新市场、半导体/医药长认证、生态尚未成熟

24—60个月或更长

技术、标准、认证、需求、融资、竞争路线

近期通常只进入P2b及乐观情景，E4—E5后才逐步进入基础利润

必须注意：

E1+L1项目可能比E3+L3项目更早变现。

“建成”不等于“商业化”；“商业化”不等于“形成正经济利润”。

现有客户已给forecast、包销或共同开发，可缩短L路径；只有模糊意向不能缩短。

共享原料、装置、技术和客户可提高最终成功率，但不能替代产品纯度、良率和客户认证证据。

对目标年份使用(P_{i,t})，对远期期权估值使用(P_{i,\infty})和时间折现，禁止直接把E阶段概率同时用于两者。

9.3 市场定价阶段M

阶段

特征

M0无人关注

产业变化尚未被市场识别

M1逻辑萌芽

少量资金关注，相对强度改善

M2预期扩散

板块形成，研报和成交增加

M3订单定价

市场开始交易客户验证和远期利润

M4主升浪

盈利预测连续上修，龙头和板块共振

M5高位兑现

隐含成功率很高、拥挤、利好钝化

最佳区间通常是E2—E3而市场仅M1—M2；危险区间是产业仍E0—E2、市场已M4—M5。

E/M阶段本身不单独加分，用于R和T，防止订单验证被重复计算。

10. 业绩弹性测算

每家公司必须建立保守、中性、乐观三情景，覆盖未来1—3年。

V2.1禁止用单一“概率加权净利润”替代情景表。必须先计算每个真实经营情景，再计算概率加权期望值。

10.1 主业基本盘

销量、价格、收入、成本、毛利率、利用率。

周期股使用正常化利润，不机械外推峰值毛利率。

明确每1000元价格、每1个百分点毛利率或每10个百分点利用率对净利润的敏感性。

10.2 新业务

当前E阶段及升阶所需证据。

成熟收入、毛利率、净利润和资本开支。

客户认证、订单、复购、扩产和量产时间。

是否足以让未来12—18个月增量利润达到公司利润的10%以上；若不能，主要属于估值期权。

标注E阶段、L路径、(P_{i,t})与(P_{i,\infty})，不得只给一个成功概率。

即使未来12—18个月利润贡献低，只要项目最终商业化概率、成熟价值和业务属性切换意义可量化，仍必须进入P2b估值；不能因为未进入基础利润而按零处理。

10.3 新产能

设计产能、实际投产、爬坡周期、利用率、订单覆盖、折旧、营运资本。

区分“建成”“试生产”“客户认证”“商业化满产”。

10.4 资本运作

是否并表、投资收益、少数股东权益、潜在融资和摊薄。

参股上市公司的市场价值与盈利贡献分开处理。

10.5 单项目利润模型

对项目(i)、年份(t)、情景(s)：

\left[
产能_i\times\frac{投产月份_{i,t,s}}{12}\times利用率_{i,t,s}\times良率_{i,t,s}
\times(单价_{i,t,s}-单位变动成本_{i,t,s})
-固定费用-折旧-财务费用
\right]
\times(1-税率)\times归属权益比例
]

必须纳入：

延期导致的实际投产月份减少；

初期低良率、低利用率和客户爬坡；

投产后亏损情景，而非只设“成功盈利”和“失败为零”；

新增折旧、费用、营运资本、利息、少数股东权益；

新业务对原有业务的协同、替代、内部转移定价及可能的产能挤占。

10.6 条件情景树与概率加权

项目通常经历：审批/融资→建设→试产良率→客户认证→批量订单→利用率和正利润。概率必须尽可能写成条件概率：

[
P_{i,t}=P(按期建设)\times P(良率达标\mid建设完成)
\times P(客户认证\mid良率达标)
\times P(订单及正利润\mid认证通过)
]

但若某个公开E阶段证据已经包含前序环节，禁止再次相乘折扣。多个项目共享客户、技术、融资或行业需求时，应建立公司级联合情景，不能假设相互独立后简单相加。

10.7 三种利润口径

口径

定义

用途

报表情景利润

保守/中性/乐观情景下实际可能出现的净利润

判断经营结果及估值区间

概率加权期望利润

(E(NP_t)=NP_{主业,t}+\sum_i\sum_sP_{i,t,s}\Delta NP_{i,t,s})

比较胜率、赔率和仓位，不代表公司必然报出的利润

全部顺利乐观上限

主业强景气、项目按期、认证和爬坡顺利的利润

计算弹性和P3/P4上限，不得冒充中性预测

每年必须进一步拆为：

年份

核心业务利润

高确定性项目利润

期权加权利润

概率加权总利润

乐观上限

11. 五层股价体系

层级

含义

P0证伪价值

核心逻辑失败后的保守价值

P1业绩锚价值

只计现有主业和高确定性修复

P2a近期期权合理价值

概率加权计入未来12—24个月可能形成利润的订单和产能期权

P2b远期期权合理价值

对近期利润贡献较小但最终商业化具有合理概率的项目，按成熟价值、最终成功概率、时间及剩余投入折现

P3A股交易区间

叠加板块趋势、注意力和业务属性切换

P4预期透支区

股价隐含大部分期权成功，利好容错率很低

每次价格推演必须明确：当前价格属于哪一层；P2a和P2b分别贡献多少；市场隐含的是目标年份兑现概率还是最终成功概率；P3相对P2的抢跑溢价；什么验证可升一层；什么证伪会退一层。

12. 主升浪判定

真正主升浪至少满足四项：

行业高频数据继续强化，而非只靠远期故事。

公司订单、价格、收入或毛利率进入上修周期。

机构盈利预测连续上调，且上调幅度能够覆盖估值扩张。

板块宽度和龙头共振，股价突破后有承接而非单日情绪脉冲。

主升浪不是必买信号。如果M阶段显著领先E阶段，应优先评估透支而非追涨。

13. 风险处罚与硬否决

13.1 普通风险（总分扣0—10）

资本开支过重、自由现金流弱。

利润增长但经营现金流、应收、库存恶化。

低回报传统业务持续扩张。

客户、订单和收入确认不透明。

股东减持、质押、再融资和摊薄。

项目延期、良率或利用率低于预期。

行业供给快速扩张，产品价格下跌。

市场隐含成功率过高、成交拥挤、利好钝化。

13.2 硬否决

审计非标、重大财务真实性问题。

严重关联交易、资金占用或治理问题。

重大安全、环保、政策或合规风险。

新业务完全依赖融资，且没有真实产业证据。

核心景气逻辑已经证伪，只能依赖题材维持股价。

14. 评分和排序规则

14.1 综合分

[
综合分=0.40G+0.20R+0.25B+0.15T-风险处罚
]

14.2 景气门槛优先于总分

G≥80：可进入核心高景气池，再比较R/B/T。

70≤G<80：高景气候选，等待验证或更好赔率。

60≤G<70：修复或局部景气，只能降低配置等级。

G<60：不能因B和T高而进入核心景气池。

14.3 必须同时输出四个结论

胜率：主要由G、治理执行和证据质量决定。

赔率：主要由R、P0/P2距离和隐含成功率决定。

弹性：由B决定，不等同于胜率。

时点：由T和E/M阶段差决定。

禁止仅凭一个综合分掩盖“高胜率低赔率”或“低胜率高弹性”。

15. 标准研究输出模板

结论先行：是否高景气、是否核心受益、当前E/M阶段、胜率/赔率/弹性/时点、一句话逻辑、核心矛盾。

全景扫描：所有主营、新业务、产能、客户、子公司、参股、海外和资本运作。

四层分类：业绩锚、修复锚、订单期权、题材期权。

分赛道景气：需求、供给、持续时间、验证指标、周期位置。

景气承接度：收入、利润、增量利润的景气暴露及低回报拖累。

业绩测算：保守/中性/乐观未来1—3年净利润，并同时给出核心业务利润、高确定性项目利润、期权加权利润、概率加权总利润和乐观上限。

期权估值：逐项目列出E阶段、L路径、目标年份兑现概率(P_{i,t})、最终成功概率(P_{i,\infty})、成熟价值、变现年限、剩余投入、基本面期权价值、已定价价值和市场隐含成功率。

市场预期：当前股价交易题材、订单、业绩、周期反转、估值切换还是资产重估。

G/R/B/T评分：列出子项和证据，避免只给主观总分。

P0—P4股价区间：明确P2a近期期权、P2b远期期权、P3抢跑溢价及各区间所需假设。

催化与证伪：未来30—90天、1年、2年节点。

最终排序：景气度、赔率、弹性、时点分别排序，再给综合排序。

16. 体系维护和回测

每次财报、重大订单、价格拐点、配额变化或项目升阶后更新E阶段、盈利模型和市场隐含概率。

保存当时可获得的信息，避免用未来结果倒推过去评分。

检验未来3、6、12个月超额收益、最大回撤、胜率和盈亏比。

分别回测需求扩张、供给约束、新业务重估、底部反转和政策主题，不能假设所有类型使用同一概率和估值。

权重若调整，必须形成新版本号并说明变更；V2.1在新版本正式确认前始终是唯一默认版本。

最终约束摘要

景气是必要条件，不用低估值替代景气。

纯度是全部高景气利润暴露，不是单一业务收入占比。

多个真实高景气业务不会因多元化扣分。

低回报业务只通过利润拖累、资本占用和现金流扣分。

不等利润全部兑现，但必须等待最小可验证信号。

产业E阶段与市场M阶段必须分开。

当前股价必须反向计算隐含成功率。

题材和远期期权可以在利润兑现前进入A股股价，但必须区分目标年份兑现概率与最终成功概率，不能100%计值。

远期期权不进入近期基础利润不代表价值为零；必须按路径长度、成熟价值、最终成功概率、时间和剩余投入计入P2b。

A股对远期期权的提前定价属于P3，必须与P2基本面期权价值分开，并反推市场隐含成功率。

价格行为只判断时点，不证明产业逻辑。

所有分析最终输出胜率、赔率、弹性、时点和P0—P4价格层级。

tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry names, descriptions, and status. A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree. running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure. corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message. While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

tools.name: list_subagent_models
tools.description: Inspect the routes available for explicit subagent model selection. No arguments: authorized providers. `provider`: that provider's authorized models. `provider` + `model`: that model and its reasoning efforts. Query when choosing an explicit child route or reasoning effort. Omit optional fields rather than sending empty strings.

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: plugin_manager
tools.description: List plugins or bundles in the current profile, enable or disable them, install a bundle, or remove an installed bundle. Every action requires danger-full-access permission or approval for this call. Approval does not change the session permission mode. Changes affect every session in this profile. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

target.description: Plugin entry id, bundle package name, or installation spec, according to action. For an Official catalog entry, pass list_bundles installTarget.spec to install_bundle.

enabled.description: Required for set operations; defaults to true for installation. For set_version_exemption, true grants and false revokes.

runtimeVersion.description: For set_version_exemption: exact DSH version from list_version_exemptions. Target must be the manifest package-name@version, not an alias or version range.

acceptRisk.description: For granting an exemption: true only after warning the user about possible crashes and data loss and receiving explicit permission for this exact plugin/runtime pair. General installation permission is not enough.

approvedBuilds.description: For install_bundle: pass names from pendingBuilds only after the user explicitly approves running their install scripts in the conversation. This grants persistent permission for this profile.

registry.description: For install_bundle: the npm registry URL asked first, when the user names one; otherwise the configured registry is asked, and its configured fallbacks while a registry is unreachable.

limit.description: List page size, from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Hosts may show presented files only after your turn ends, so call it once the files are final. If the user needs to review files earlier, such as before a tool call that waits for their answer, link them in your message instead. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: schedule_edit
tools.description: Update, pause, resume, or delete one scheduled task by id. Deleting does not retract queued messages.

action.description: update applies the provided fields, at least one; delete removes the task.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

prompt.description: New instruction delivered at each occurrence.

rrule.description: New recurrence in the schedule_create rrule format.

target.description: Omit to retain the destination and its creation settings. Providing target replaces them; new_once reserves a different Session. New targets capture this Session's working directory and preset. Choices are the same as schedule_create.

active.description: false pauses the task; true resumes only if its timing has a future occurrence. Otherwise provide a new rrule.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt from the latest result that returned this task; if the task changed after that result, the result is schedule_conflict and nothing changes.

tools.name: schedule_list
tools.description: List scheduled tasks, including tasks created from other sessions. Active tasks come first, ordered by scheduledAt.

active.description: true for active tasks only; false for paused and ended tasks only; omitted for all tasks.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 500; defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of tasks to skip; defaults to 0.

tools.name: schedule_view
tools.description: View one scheduled task by id.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to an agent. A working agent receives it at its next step; an idle agent starts a new turn with it. Returns delivery confirmation.

agent.description: The name of another agent in your subagent tree, as shown by list_agents.

message.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes. Omit `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` to use child defaults, falling back to compatible parent values.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display. Use the language of the user's current request.

name.description: Optional short name for the subagent, unique among the subagents you create: lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter, at most 32 characters; lead is reserved for the root agent. Omitted names default to agent-1, agent-2, and so on.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

model.description: Model id within that provider; requires `provider`.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort id; requires `provider` and `model`. Omit to use the selected model's default, even when it matches the parent or configured route.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display. Use the language of the user's current request.

name.description: Optional short name for the subagent, unique among the subagents you create: lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter, at most 32 characters; lead is reserved for the root agent. Omitted names default to agent-1, agent-2, and so on.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress; skip it for trivial single-step tasks. Add one todo per concrete step before you start. While work remains, keep the todos being worked on `in_progress`, several only when work runs in parallel. Mark each todo `completed` as soon as it is done.

todos.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

content.description: What the task is — a short imperative line.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update the current goal.

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

action.description: edit, pause, and resume require a direct top-level human request. complete and blocked are also allowed during an automatic continuation of this goal; blocked is rejected before the configured minimum round count.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds and blocks progress.

tools.name: wait_agent
tools.description: Wait for input at your next step, including agent messages, completion notifications, and user steering. Returns immediately if new input is pending. `timedOut: false` means new input is pending. Pending input is delivered to the model after code execution finishes.

timeout_ms.description: Wait duration in milliseconds, from 10000 through 3600000. Defaults to 30000.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information. Returns an optional summary answer and a list of source URLs.

queries.description: 1–10 search queries; their results are merged.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

data.title: A股景气投资体系 V2.1（完整版

content.text:
从机构买方投研与实战组合管理的视角来看，这套 **《A股景气投资体系 V2.1》** 是一套**完成度极高、经历过真实A股周期毒打后进化出的“结构化基本面投研框架”**。

它不仅超越了散户常见的“概念+PE”粗放模式，也明显迭代了2019—2021年A股早期景气投资“唯增速论、忽视估值容量与竞争格局”的缺陷；同时，它的规则颗粒度与防呆约束设计，使其天然具备作为 **AI投研Agent底层宪法（System Prompt / SOP）** 的工程化水准。

以下从**总体定性、五大核心突破、五个实战隐患（挑刺）、以及后续迭代建议**四个维度给出客观评价：

---

### 一、 总体定性：从“第一代景气追涨”进化到“预期差与期权定价”

传统A股景气投资最容易死在两个极端：
1. **死于教条价值**：看不懂尚未贡献当期EPS的新业务（如半导体材料导入、新冷媒、新技术路线），因为2027年没有利润就给0估值，错失整个产业重估主升浪；
2. **死于叙事抢跑**：把远期峰值空间（TAM）乘以100%成功率折算成当期目标价，在产业尚处 `E1`（立项）、市场已达 `M4—M5`（高潮）时重仓接盘。

**V2.1最大的含金量，在于用一套自洽的数学与逻辑语言，把“A股极其擅长提前抢跑的交易生态”与“严谨的基本面概率折现”做了物理隔离与桥梁打通。**

---

### 二、 五大核心亮点（切中A股实战要害的设计）

#### 1. 拆解 $P_{i,t}$ 与 $P_{i,\infty}$，并剥离 P2（基本面期权）与 P3（A股抢跑溢价）
这是V2.1最精彩的一刀。很多研究员在面对远期项目时，要么不敢给估值，要么为了凑目标价强行上调后两年的盈利预测（污染利润表）。
* 将**目标年份兑现概率 $P_{i,t}$**（决定近1—3年期望利润）与**最终商业化概率 $P_{i,\infty}$**（决定P2b远期期权折现）拆开，既保住了近端财务模型的干净，又给真正具备产业协同的远期大单品留出了合理估值位置。
* 将 **P3（题材扩散、板块共振带来的提前计价）** 单独拎出，承认它的客观存在但拒绝将其混同于基本面价值（P2），这在认知上解决了A股成长股“为什么涨过合理估值还能涨，以及退潮时到底往哪跌”的核心难题。

#### 2. 重构“有效景气纯度”，打破“单一收入占比”的机械教条
文中用**三美股份（单赛道高弹性纯度）**与**巨化股份（多赛道高景气叠加的平台型纯度）**做的对比，极具一线实战体感。
* 过去市场习惯用“某热门业务占营收比不足10%”一票否决平台型龙头，或者对多元化公司无脑给折价。
* V2.1改用 **“20%收入暴露 + 40%当期利润暴露 + 40%增量利润暴露 + 协同加分 - 低回报拖累”**，准确抓住了股价定价的本质——**股票定的是边际增量利润与ROIC结构改善的价，而不是历史存量收入结构的价**。

#### 3. 在 `E（产业证据）× M（市场定价）` 之外引入 `L（变现路径长度）`
很多双阶段模型只有产业阶段和市场阶段，但V2.1敏锐地指出了 **`E1+L1` 可能快于 `E3+L3`**：
* 成熟化工品/制造业的存量技改扩产（L1），立项后半年就能见利润；而半导体前驱体/光刻胶或创新药（L3），即便已经送样甚至过初审（E2—E3），距离真正贡献大额正经济利润可能还有2—4年。引入L维度，极大降低了跨行业比较时的“验证幻觉”。

#### 4. 严苛的“防重复计分”与“反向估值（Implied Probability）”纪律
买方实战中最怕把好公司买贵。V2.1设置了两道极佳的防火墙：
* **防重复折价与防重复计值**：明确规定已进入期望利润的部分不能再全额进SOTP；明确区分失败概率（进 $P_{i,\infty}$）、时间成本（进 $r_i$）与生意质量（进 $Q_i$），避免感性拍脑袋导致的双重计算或双重惩罚。
* **先反推隐含成功率，再谈预期差**：强制要求用当前市值减去业绩锚/修复锚后，倒推市场已经price-in了多少成功率。这直接扼杀了卖方研报常见的“因为产业好，所以继续买”的线性外推谬误。

#### 5. G分硬门槛（G≥60/80）与“市场辨识度仅占总分1.25%”
* 综合公式中 `B（弹性）` 占25%，而“市场辨识度”只占 `B` 的5%（即总分的 **1.25%**），同时规定 `G<60` 硬性不入核心池、强制并列输出“胜率/赔率/弹性/时点”四个独立结论。这保证了体系内核始终锚定在**产业趋势驱动的基本面投资**，而不会在牛市躁动中退化为游资龙头战法。

---

### 二、 深度审视与“挑刺”：实战落地的五个潜在隐患

如果将这套体系投入真实的大资金组合管理或高频AI投研调用，以下几个结构性张力需要高度警惕：

#### 1. 长链条公式带来的“伪精确（Pseudo-Precision）”与结果倒推风险
在6.1节与10.5节中，P2b期权价值依赖 $P_{i,\infty,s} \times V_{\text{成熟},i,s} \times Q_{i,s} / (1+r_i)^{T_{i,s}} - PV(\text{Capex})$，单项目利润依赖“产能×月份×利用率×良率×价差-折旧费用”。
* **实战痛点**：在连环相乘的公式里，如果每个参数都由研究者主观赋一个连续数值——比如终局成功率给35%还是50%、质量系数 $Q$ 给0.7还是0.9、折现率 $r$ 给10%还是14%、成熟年限 $T$ 给3年还是4.5年——**几个参数微调20%，算出来的P2b估值就能相差3到5倍**。
* **后果**：极易出现“心理上先看多某只票，再微调 $Q_i, r_i, T_i$ 把P2b凑到当前市值之上”的确认偏误（尤其在让AI执行时，AI若缺乏硬数据，极易编造看似合理的中间参数）。

#### 2. “拥挤度与预期透支”的惩罚权重偏低，难以防御“高G白马的戴维斯双杀”
复盘2021年底至2023年的新能源、CXO、部分半导体设备：在股价见顶后的最初两个季度里，它们的行业高频数据、订单排产、当期业绩增速全部处于极高水平（按V2.1打分，`G` 依然在85分以上，`E` 处于E4—E5）。
* 在现有权重中，“拥挤度和筹码健康”仅占 `T（15%）` 中的10%，即**仅占综合分的 1.5%**；哪怕加上普通风险扣分（0—10分），一个处于 `E4 + M5`（业绩极好但机构极度拥挤、边际买盘枯竭）的核心龙头，依然可能算出一个很高的综合分。
* **本质问题**：当 **M阶段显著超前于E阶段（如E1/M4）** 或 **M进入M5极度拥挤区** 时，风险不是线性的减几分，而是赔率结构的非线性坍塌。

#### 3. 同一套 `G` 评分表横跨“需求扩张型成长”与“供给约束型周期”存在天然错配
1.1节将AI算力/创新药（需求扩张）与制冷剂/航运/大宗化工（供给约束周期）纳入同一套 `G` 子项权重：
* 对于AI、创新药，“业绩订单现金流已验证（15分）+ 需求加速（15分）”往往对应主升浪中段；
* 但对于**强周期品或底部反转股**，买点往往出现在“供给端配额/产能出清已锁死，价格刚起苗头，但当期财报利润和现金流依然很烂、需求增速甚至只是温和复苏”的时刻。按4.1节打分，这类周期拐点股很容易因为“需求增速一般+当期财报未验证”而卡在 `G=62~68分`（被降级处理）；等到它财报现金流全面验证、拿到 `G=85分` 时，往往已经是周期高点（低PE陷阱）。

#### 4. 多期权平台型公司的“隐含成功率反推”存在注意力归因失真
6.4节意识到了多期权汇总反推的扭曲，提出“按研究判断的相对权重分配市场已定价期权”。
* **A股现实**：A股对多期权公司的定价从来不是按基本面权重均匀分配的，而是**“单点叙事极化定价”**。例如某氟化工龙头同时有HFO冷媒、PVDF、半导体冷却液、含氟聚合物四个期权，当月市场炒AI液冷时，溢价市值其实100%是冲着冷却液去的（该单项隐含成功率可能已泡沫化至120%），而另外三个期权市场根本没看（隐含成功率0%）。如果按研究端权重平摊已定价期权，会低估热门期权的泡沫程度、高估冷门期权的计价程度。

#### 5. 选股与定价闭环极强，但“动态退出机制”与“仓位映射”略显单薄
体系非常清晰地回答了“买什么、值多少、现在贵不贵”，但在组合管理端还缺最后半步：
* 当股价从 `P2` 涨入 `P3（抢跑溢价区）` 甚至触碰 `P4` 时，如果 `G` 和 `E` 依然强劲（产业没证伪，只是涨多了），标准动作是**锁盈减仓、持有让利润奔跑、还是用均线/回撤右侧止盈**？
* 当 `M阶段退潮（板块轮动下跌）` 但 `E阶段不变（基本面没坏）`，股价从 `P3` 跌回 `P1/P2` 时，风控规则如何区分“正常去抢跑泡沫（该加仓）”与“市场聪明钱提前嗅到了尚未公开的产业恶化（该止损）”？

---

### 三、 迈向 V2.2 的优化建议（保持现有骨架下的微调）

这套V2.1已经非常扎实，不需要推倒重来，只需在实操层面打几个“工程补丁”，就能大幅提升实战鲁棒性：

1. **核心参数“分档离散化”，限制自由裁量权（防凑数）**
   * 对 $r_i$（折现率）、$Q_i$（质量系数）、$P_{i,\infty}$ 不要允许随意填小数，而是做成**固定档位查表制**。例如：$r_i$ 只设三档（L1成熟扩产 10% / L2跨客户导入 13% / L3新技术路线 16%）；$Q_i$ 只设三档（强壁垒高ROIC 1.0 / 制造业平均水平 0.7 / 强周期重资产无壁垒 0.4）。锁死参数自由度后，不同标的之间的横向打分才真正可比。
2. **对 `M - E` 阶段差引入“非线性熔断/降档规则”**
   * 虽然E/M不直接重复加分，但建议在14.2节增加一条硬约束：**凡处于 `M5`，或 `M - E ≥ 2`（例如产业仅E1立项，市场已炒到M3/M4）的标的，无论综合分多高，赔率 `R` 强制封顶（如不超过40分），且自动归入“交易博弈池/观察减仓池”，不得作为核心底仓新建仓**。
3. **增设“数据缺失降级条款”（尤其针对AI协作场景）**
   * 明确规定：若某新业务缺乏A/B级来源的产能、单价或客户进展披露（仅有D级互动易或传闻），**禁止强行套用10.5节单项目利润公式编造参数**，直接强制归为 `E0/E1`，近期期望利润计为 `0`，仅允许在P2b中按行业可比重置成本或极低先验上限给予定性标注。
4. **补充“四维结论 → 仓位象限与卖出触发器”映射表**
   * 建立简单的仓位纪律：例如 `高G + 高R + 右侧T（E2~E3 / M1~M2）` 对应重仓主攻区；`高G + 低R + 强T（E4 / M4）` 对应趋势持仓区（只持不追，破趋势线减半）；`E降阶或核心高频指标连续两月证伪` 对应无条件清仓线（不等跌回P0）。

### 总结评价

如果按100分给这套投研体系打分，**它的理论架构与A股本土化适配度可以打到 90分以上**。它成功把买方基金经理脑中往往依赖“盘感”和“经验”的**纯度辨析、期权折现、抢跑溢价剥离与隐含赔率反推**，沉淀成了可复现、可审计、可回测的显性算法。只要在实际执行中控制好“长公式参数主观凑数”的问题，并补齐高位拥挤度风控与卖出纪律，这就是一套极具实战杀伤力的A股超额收益母本。

它不仅超越了散户常见的“概念+PE”粗放模式，也明显迭代了2019—2021年A股早期景气投资“唯增速论、忽视估值容量与竞争格局”的缺陷；同时，它的规则颗粒度与防呆约束设计，使其天然具备作为 **AI投研Agent底层宪法（System Prompt / SOP）** 的工程化水准。

以下从**总体定性、五大核心突破、五个实战隐患（挑刺）、以及后续迭代建议**四个维度给出客观评价：

---

### 一、 总体定性：从“第一代景气追涨”进化到“预期差与期权定价”

传统A股景气投资最容易死在两个极端：
1. **死于教条价值**：看不懂尚未贡献当期EPS的新业务（如半导体材料导入、新冷媒、新技术路线），因为2027年没有利润就给0估值，错失整个产业重估主升浪；
2. **死于叙事抢跑**：把远期峰值空间（TAM）乘以100%成功率折算成当期目标价，在产业尚处 `E1`（立项）、市场已达 `M4—M5`（高潮）时重仓接盘。

**V2.1最大的含金量，在于用一套自洽的数学与逻辑语言，把“A股极其擅长提前抢跑的交易生态”与“严谨的基本面概率折现”做了物理隔离与桥梁打通。**

---

### 二、 五大核心亮点（切中A股实战要害的设计）

#### 1. 拆解 $P_{i,t}$ 与 $P_{i,\infty}$，并剥离 P2（基本面期权）与 P3（A股抢跑溢价）
这是V2.1最精彩的一刀。很多研究员在面对远期项目时，要么不敢给估值，要么为了凑目标价强行上调后两年的盈利预测（污染利润表）。
* 将**目标年份兑现概率 $P_{i,t}$**（决定近1—3年期望利润）与**最终商业化概率 $P_{i,\infty}$**（决定P2b远期期权折现）拆开，既保住了近端财务模型的干净，又给真正具备产业协同的远期大单品留出了合理估值位置。
* 将 **P3（题材扩散、板块共振带来的提前计价）** 单独拎出，承认它的客观存在但拒绝将其混同于基本面价值（P2），这在认知上解决了A股成长股“为什么涨过合理估值还能涨，以及退潮时到底往哪跌”的核心难题。

#### 2. 重构“有效景气纯度”，打破“单一收入占比”的机械教条
文中用**三美股份（单赛道高弹性纯度）**与**巨化股份（多赛道高景气叠加的平台型纯度）**做的对比，极具一线实战体感。
* 过去市场习惯用“某热门业务占营收比不足10%”一票否决平台型龙头，或者对多元化公司无脑给折价。
* V2.1改用 **“20%收入暴露 + 40%当期利润暴露 + 40%增量利润暴露 + 协同加分 - 低回报拖累”**，准确抓住了股价定价的本质——**股票定的是边际增量利润与ROIC结构改善的价，而不是历史存量收入结构的价**。

#### 3. 在 `E（产业证据）× M（市场定价）` 之外引入 `L（变现路径长度）`
很多双阶段模型只有产业阶段和市场阶段，但V2.1敏锐地指出了 **`E1+L1` 可能快于 `E3+L3`**：
* 成熟化工品/制造业的存量技改扩产（L1），立项后半年就能见利润；而半导体前驱体/光刻胶或创新药（L3），即便已经送样甚至过初审（E2—E3），距离真正贡献大额正经济利润可能还有2—4年。引入L维度，极大降低了跨行业比较时的“验证幻觉”。

#### 4. 严苛的“防重复计分”与“反向估值（Implied Probability）”纪律
买方实战中最怕把好公司买贵。V2.1设置了两道极佳的防火墙：
* **防重复折价与防重复计值**：明确规定已进入期望利润的部分不能再全额进SOTP；明确区分失败概率（进 $P_{i,\infty}$）、时间成本（进 $r_i$）与生意质量（进 $Q_i$），避免感性拍脑袋导致的双重计算或双重惩罚。
* **先反推隐含成功率，再谈预期差**：强制要求用当前市值减去业绩锚/修复锚后，倒推市场已经price-in了多少成功率。这直接扼杀了卖方研报常见的“因为产业好，所以继续买”的线性外推谬误。

#### 5. G分硬门槛（G≥60/80）与“市场辨识度仅占总分1.25%”
* 综合公式中 `B（弹性）` 占25%，而“市场辨识度”只占 `B` 的5%（即总分的 **1.25%**），同时规定 `G<60` 硬性不入核心池、强制并列输出“胜率/赔率/弹性/时点”四个独立结论。这保证了体系内核始终锚定在**产业趋势驱动的基本面投资**，而不会在牛市躁动中退化为游资龙头战法。

---

### 二、 深度审视与“挑刺”：实战落地的五个潜在隐患

在6.1节与10.5节中，P2b期权价值依赖 $P_{i,\infty,s} \times V_{\text{成熟},i,s} \times Q_{i,s} / (1+r_i)^{T_{i,s}} - PV(\text{Capex})$，单项目利润依赖“产能×月份×利用率×良率×价差-折旧费用”。
* **实战痛点**：在连环相乘的公式里，如果每个参数都由研究者主观赋一个连续数值——比如终局成功率给35%还是50%、质量系数 $Q$ 给0.7还是0.9、折现率 $r$ 给10%还是14%、成熟年限 $T$ 给3年还是4.5年——**几个参数微调20%，算出来的P2b估值就能相差3到5倍**。
* **后果**：极易出现“心理上先看多某只票，再微调 $Q_i, r_i, T_i$ 把P2b凑到当前市值之上”的确认偏误（尤其在让AI执行时，AI若缺乏硬数据，极易编造看似合理的中间参数）。

#### 2. “拥挤度与预期透支”的惩罚权重偏低，难以防御“高G白马的戴维斯双杀”
复盘2021年底至2023年的新能源、CXO、部分半导体设备：在股价见顶后的最初两个季度里，它们的行业高频数据、订单排产、当期业绩增速全部处于极高水平（按V2.1打分，`G` 依然在85分以上，`E` 处于E4—E5）。
* 在现有权重中，“拥挤度和筹码健康”仅占 `T（15%）` 中的10%，即**仅占综合分的 1.5%**；哪怕加上普通风险扣分（0—10分），一个处于 `E4 + M5`（业绩极好但机构极度拥挤、边际买盘枯竭）的核心龙头，依然可能算出一个很高的综合分。
* **本质问题**：当 **M阶段显著超前于E阶段（如E1/M4）** 或 **M进入M5极度拥挤区** 时，风险不是线性的减几分，而是赔率结构的非线性坍塌。

1.1节将AI算力/创新药（需求扩张）与制冷剂/航运/大宗化工（供给约束周期）纳入同一套 `G` 子项权重：
* 对于AI、创新药，“业绩订单现金流已验证（15分）+ 需求加速（15分）”往往对应主升浪中段；
* 但对于**强周期品或底部反转股**，买点往往出现在“供给端配额/产能出清已锁死，价格刚起苗头，但当期财报利润和现金流依然很烂、需求增速甚至只是温和复苏”的时刻。按4.1节打分，这类周期拐点股很容易因为“需求增速一般+当期财报未验证”而卡在 `G=62~68分`（被降级处理）；等到它财报现金流全面验证、拿到 `G=85分` 时，往往已经是周期高点（低PE陷阱）。

#### 4. 多期权平台型公司的“隐含成功率反推”存在注意力归因失真
6.4节意识到了多期权汇总反推的扭曲，提出“按研究判断的相对权重分配市场已定价期权”。
* **A股现实**：A股对多期权公司的定价从来不是按基本面权重均匀分配的，而是**“单点叙事极化定价”**。例如某氟化工龙头同时有HFO冷媒、PVDF、半导体冷却液、含氟聚合物四个期权，当月市场炒AI液冷时，溢价市值其实100%是冲着冷却液去的（该单项隐含成功率可能已泡沫化至120%），而另外三个期权市场根本没看（隐含成功率0%）。如果按研究端权重平摊已定价期权，会低估热门期权的泡沫程度、高估冷门期权的计价程度。

#### 5. 选股与定价闭环极强，但“动态退出机制”与“仓位映射”略显单薄
体系非常清晰地回答了“买什么、值多少、现在贵不贵”，但在组合管理端还缺最后半步：
* 当股价从 `P2` 涨入 `P3（抢跑溢价区）` 甚至触碰 `P4` 时，如果 `G` 和 `E` 依然强劲（产业没证伪，只是涨多了），标准动作是**锁盈减仓、持有让利润奔跑、还是用均线/回撤右侧止盈**？

# @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions
English | [中文](README.zh.md)
## Summary

`dsh-agent-instructions` gives agents workspace guidance from user-global and project-level `AGENTS.md`-compatible files. It loads the applicable chain for the first request. It does not watch external edits continuously: successful filesystem operations discover newly relevant nested files and make later changes or removals visible, while session resume reconciles the baseline. `dsh-base` enables this behavior by default, while profiles can disable it. A byte budget bounds the user-global chain and the project chain separately: within each chain, broader files are omitted before the most specific file is truncated, and an empty chain adds nothing.
## Table of Contents
- [Use this package](#use-this-package)
- [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation)
- [Further Exploration](#further-exploration)
- [Model Experience](#model-experience)
- [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work)
- [Dev Note](#dev-note)
## Use this package
Changing the Session's working directory reloads the applicable project instruction chain before the next request.

Mount this plugin when agents should work from the workspace's own instruction files. `dsh-base` already includes it with a 65,536-byte budget for each instruction chain, so base-backed profiles only need to replace the row when they want another `maxBytes`; providerless trees load nothing until a filesystem provider is present.
### What the agent gets

The first request includes one durable baseline message with the user-global chain — `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`, then `<agentsHome>/AGENTS.md` — followed by the project chain: every existing candidate file from the project root down to the session working directory, in broad-to-specific order. Within one candidate group, files whose content matches after trimming render once: a `CLAUDE.md` that duplicates its `AGENTS.md` is not repeated, and a shared-root `AGENTS.md` that duplicates the harness-home file collapses behind it. After a successful `read`, `write`, or `edit` call reaches a deeper directory, the next request includes the newly applicable instruction file; a changed file replaces its content, and a file that disappears or duplicates an earlier candidate produces a removal notice.
### Configuration

The defaults suit a typical checkout: `.git` marks the project root, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are the base candidates, and `AGENTS.local.md` and `CLAUDE.local.md` are additive local overlays. Only `maxBytes` is required — it caps the user-global chain and the project chain separately within each rendered message, so each deployment chooses its prompt budget explicitly; a message that holds both chains is at most twice `maxBytes`.

The harness home holding the user-global `AGENTS.md` is process policy rather than row configuration: the plugin resolves `$DSH_HOME`, or `~/.dsh`, through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`, so instruction loading always reads the process home. The shared agents root resolves the same way, from `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` or `~/.agents`. Stray `dshHome` and `agentsHome` row keys are ignored.

Root discovery climbs only when a marker probe confirms that the marker is absent. A permission or I/O failure stops discovery and surfaces the host or filesystem-provider error instead of selecting an ancestor project. The [historical root-marker metadata decision](../../../.agents/notes/archived/bug-fix/2026-09-03-root-marker-metadata-failures.md) records why discovery fails instead of substituting another root.
```yaml
- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
config:
maxBytes: 65536
The accepted fields, at a glance:
```ts
export interface Config {
projectRootMarkers?: string[]
maxBytes: number
maxSourceBytes?: number
instructionFileCandidates?: string[]
localInstructionFileCandidates?: string[]
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `maxBytes` | required | Cap on each instruction chain (user-global, project) in one rendered message, in bytes; a message holding both chains is at most twice this size |
| `maxSourceBytes` | `1048576` | Cap on one source instruction file before rendering |
| `projectRootMarkers` | `['.git']` | Directory names that mark the project root |
| `instructionFileCandidates` | `['AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md']` | Base file names loaded in each project directory |
| `localInstructionFileCandidates` | `['AGENTS.local.md', 'CLAUDE.local.md']` | Local overlay file names loaded after the base files |
The generated [configuration catalog](../../../docs/config-catalog.md#deepseek-aidsh-agent-instructions) is the exhaustive source for every accepted field and its JSDoc.
### Observing the budget

Rendering budgets the user-global chain and the project chain separately, each under `maxBytes`. Within a chain it keeps the most specific files first: it drops whole broader files, truncates the last remaining file, and then falls back to a compact intro, to the budget notice with that file's empty heading, and finally to the notice alone. User-global files are therefore omitted or truncated only when they exceed their own budget, with the harness-home file omitted before the shared-root file, except in the fallback below. A visible `Workspace instruction budget ...` notice names the omitted and truncated paths of both chains. An over-budget broad file is ignored; during refresh it is treated as temporarily unavailable rather than removed.

When all files fit within `maxBytes` together, the message holds them with no budget notice; when only one chain has files, that chain renders alone under `maxBytes`. Otherwise one `<system-reminder>` frame holds the merged budget notice when a file was omitted or truncated, one intro when a chain kept its frame, and the rendered sections of both chains in their loaded order, which puts user-global files first in a baseline; this message can exceed `maxBytes` and is at most twice that size. When a chain renders without a frame and the merged frame would exceed twice `maxBytes`, all files render as one chain under one `maxBytes` instead, which can omit a user-global file that fit its own budget; this needs a budget of a few hundred bytes or a budget notice that nearly fills or exceeds `maxBytes`. The [per-chain budget decision](../../../.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-10-16-separate-instruction-chain-budgets.md) records why the two chains are budgeted separately.
## Understand the implementation
<details>
<summary>Implementation internals — click to expand</summary>
This section explains the design decisions behind the plugin; the observable behavior is covered in [Use this package](#use-this-package).
### Design concept

The plugin is built on one principle: workspace instructions are durable conversation content, owned per agent and per session. Baseline and refresh messages are ordinary sourced `user/message` events, so they replay, compact, and resume exactly like other history, and model-visible state is always reconstructable from the session log. The plugin owns the complete `<system-reminder>` framing and every injected message reaches the model verbatim.
### Source map
| File | Role |
| [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts) | Plugin entry: pre-step listener, `tools/result` touch tracking, inbox composition |
| [`src/config.ts`](src/config.ts) | `Config` schema, budget resolution, baseline identity |
| [`src/files.ts`](src/files.ts) | Candidate discovery, project-root search, bounded streaming reads |
| [`src/render.ts`](src/render.ts) | Instruction rendering, per-chain budget truncation, change records |
| [`src/state.ts`](src/state.ts) | Durable message sources, version/digest cache, reconciliation |
| [`src/digest.ts`](src/digest.ts) | SHA-1 content identity and per-candidate-group duplicate keys |
### Main flow

At the first eligible `agent/pre-step` of a session, the plugin composes the baseline and folds it into the entering batch right after the claimed messages. Successful first-party `read`, `write`, and `edit` calls contribute touches that bubble up through parent execution tokens; once the enclosing step is durable, a projection reconciles the visible session state against the inbox and queues additions, replacements, or removals. An unchanged path with an unchanged digest is never injected again. Discovery follows structured filesystem activity rather than shell navigation, because each local shell call starts a fresh process and parsing arbitrary shell syntax is not a reliable filesystem seam.
### Invariants

Every injected message carries a typed source with its change list; a complete baseline also carries an identity derived from normalized discovery, precedence, project-root, and budget configuration, and a matching durable message confirms a queued baseline. Model-visible text contains no hidden state markers, and literal `</system-reminder>` text anywhere in instruction content or model-visible metadata is escaped so repository-controlled text cannot close the plugin-owned frame.
</details>
## Further Exploration
Read these pages when the package-level contract is not enough. They move from the instruction-file format to the design decision and the exhaustive configuration.
- [Documentation standard](../../../docs/AGENTS.md) — what `AGENTS.md` instruction files contain and how they are maintained.
- [Workspace-context decision record](../../../.agents/notes/archived/feature/2026-06-24-workspace-context.md) — per-agent/session isolation and lifecycle rationale.
- [Context group map](../README.md) — sibling request-context packages.
- [Generated configuration catalog](../../../docs/config-catalog.md#deepseek-aidsh-agent-instructions) — every accepted config field and its source declaration.
## Model Experience
### Baseline context
#### What the model sees

At the first request, derived history contains one durable user-role message with the bounded user-global and project instruction chain in broad-to-specific order. Resume reuses that message when its visible baseline is compatible.
##### Baseline instruction template
```markdown
<system-reminder>

The following workspace instructions may be relevant to your work. Use them as guidance when applicable. More specific instructions take precedence over broader ones. They do not override system, developer, or direct user instructions.
Instructions from: ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md
<user-global-instructions>
Instructions from: ~/.agents/AGENTS.md
<shared-agents-instructions>
Instructions from: AGENTS.md
<project-instructions>
</system-reminder>
#### Token effect

The rendered baseline is appended once and remains in derived history until compaction. `maxBytes` bounds the user-global chain and the project chain separately, so a baseline that holds both is at most twice `maxBytes`; within each chain, broader files are omitted before the most-specific file is truncated, and an empty chain contributes zero tokens.
#### KV Cache effect

Append-only after the existing reusable prefix. Resume preserves reuse when the visible baseline identity is compatible; an incompatible identity appends a complete replacement, so discovery, precedence, project-root, or budget changes affect reuse only from that history position.
### Newly discovered scope context
#### What the model sees

After a successful first-party filesystem call reaches a deeper directory, the next request includes one retained sourced `user/message` with the newly applicable instruction file. A user-global file discovered after the baseline renders the same section with `These user-global instructions apply to all work.` in place of the scope sentence below, because a user-global scope directory is an internal reconciliation key rather than a project directory.
##### Additional instruction template
```markdown
<system-reminder>
Additional instructions from: packages/app/AGENTS.md

These instructions apply to work under `packages/app`. Use them as guidance when relevant; more specific instructions take precedence. They do not override system, developer, or direct user instructions.
<nested-instructions>
</system-reminder>
#### Token effect

Each discovered scope adds bounded history tokens until compaction. Unchanged content is suppressed by visible session state plus version/digest comparison, and PTC mode defers the same message until after the outer `run_code` result and its enclosing durable step.
#### KV Cache effect
Append-only; newly visible content follows the reusable request prefix and does not invalidate existing KV Cache entries.
### Changed or removed instruction context
#### What the model sees

A changed file produces `Updated instructions from: <path>` plus its replacement content. A candidate that disappears or becomes a per-directory duplicate of an earlier candidate produces the removal notice below.
##### Removal notice
```markdown
<system-reminder>
Instructions removed: packages/app/AGENTS.md
The previously loaded instructions from this file no longer apply.
</system-reminder>
#### Token effect

Each batch of confirmed changes or removals is one retained history message. `maxBytes` bounds each instruction chain in it, so a batch with user-global and project changes is at most twice `maxBytes`. Provider failures add no message, and an update omitted by the budget remains eligible for a later filesystem touch.
#### KV Cache effect
Append-only; newly visible content follows the reusable request prefix and does not invalidate existing KV Cache entries.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
These limits define when instruction loading is a poor fit or needs operational awareness. They are current package constraints, not a task backlog.

- **Discovery follows structured fs tools, not shell navigation** — a `bash` command that changes directories does not trigger nested instruction discovery because shell syntax and per-call shell state are not a reliable filesystem seam.

- **Refresh is touch-driven** — there is no watcher; external edits become visible on the next successful first-party `read`, `write`, or `edit`, when resume reconciles a visible baseline, or when an entering pre-step restores a shadowed baseline.

- **Candidate semantics stay intentionally small** — lowercase names, `.claude/rules/`, and `@path` imports are not interpreted; project scopes load `AGENTS.local.md`/`CLAUDE.local.md` overlays by default, but neither user-global root has a local overlay and other custom names require explicit candidate configuration. A project directory named like a user-global scope directory renders as `./<name>/...`, so it keeps its own scope instead of resolving to the global root.

- **Deduplication is content-based within one candidate group** — candidates collapse only when byte-identical after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. The two user-global roots share one group, so the shared-root file collapses behind a matching harness-home file; sibling project candidates collapse the same way, while a distinct real copy that has drifted from `AGENTS.md` loads in full alongside it. A duplicate of budget-retained content stays reconciled: when the retained candidate changes or disappears, the duplicate becomes visible again. Unchanged hidden duplicates, including files removed from visible state as duplicates, use cached metadata instead of content reads.

- **One candidate group shares failure fate** — when metadata or content cannot be read for any candidate, including a hidden duplicate, the group keeps its last-good state for that pass. An unreadable shared agents root therefore also postpones a harness-home change notice until a later pass observes both roots.

- **A byte-budget omission does not re-enter reconciliation** — a candidate that its chain's budget dropped from the baseline, including any content duplicate of that candidate, is not probed again while that visible baseline holds; it becomes visible only after the baseline is rebuilt.

- **Symlinked instruction files are followed across the trust boundary** — a candidate whose final component is a symlink is resolved and its target loaded, so a cloned repository can surface off-tree file content as lower-authority workspace guidance (it never overrides system, developer, or direct user instructions). Confine `ctx.fs` with the filesystem policy gate or an OS sandbox when loading untrusted repositories.

- **Instruction content is bounded, not summarized** — within each chain, over-budget broad files are omitted and the chain's most-specific file may be truncated; the plugin never asks a model to compress instruction prose.
- **Budget is not shared across chains** — bytes one chain leaves unused do not extend the other, so a 70 KiB user-global file is truncated to fit `maxBytes` even when the project chain uses 1 KiB.

# @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem
English | [中文](README.zh.md)
## Summary

Agents can use local skills from the repository, a custom directory, or the user's agent configuration: author a skill as a directory bundle with a `SKILL.md` or a flat `<name>.md` file under any scanned root, and it appears in the session catalog. The provider discovers the project, custom, and user roots, parses each skill's YAML frontmatter, and watches the directories, so new, renamed, or deleted skills reach agents without a restart. Choose it when skills live on disk — the registry (`dsh-skill`) accepts any provider, and another provider can supply skills from elsewhere.
## Table of Contents
- [Use this package](#use-this-package)
- [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation)
- [Further Exploration](#further-exploration)
- [Model Experience](#model-experience)
- [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work)
- [Dev Note](#dev-note)
## Use this package

Mount the plugin to make local skills available to agents. It scans the project, custom, and user skill roots below, parses each skill's frontmatter into a catalog entry, and loads the body on demand; it also watches the roots so new, renamed, or deleted skills reach the next catalog without a restart.
### When to choose it

Use this provider when skills live on disk — in the repository, a custom directory, or the user's agent configuration. Avoid it when skills come from a remote registry or embedded plugin data: the registry accepts any provider, and this package is one implementation.
### Skill format

A skill is either a directory bundle `<name>/SKILL.md` or a flat file `<name>.md` at the top level of a scanned root; nested `**/SKILL.md` files are deliberately not discovered. The file starts with YAML frontmatter: required `name` and `description`, plus optional `whenToUse`, `metadata`, `disable-model-invocation`, and `user-invocable`.

`disable-model-invocation: true` keeps the skill out of model-facing catalogs and loaders; `user-invocable: false` keeps it out of human-facing commands, and omitted fields default to permitting their surface. The two keys accept YAML booleans plus the case-insensitive `true`/`false`, `yes`/`no`, `on`/`off`, and `1`/`0` forms; a rejected spelling or a non-boolean value drops the whole skill with a warning rather than silently permitting a surface.

Catalog entries and loaded skills expose the resolved instruction-file path, so symlinked directories and flat files can open as regular-file previews. Reload locators and resource bases retain the discovered paths, including symlinks.

The catalog and the body have separate lifecycles: discovery parses frontmatter into the catalog entry, and every load re-reads the current file, so editing a skill body needs no versioning or cache invalidation.
### Roots and priority
Default roots are scanned in this provider's rank order:
| Rank | Source | Path |
| 100 | `project-dsh` | `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills` |
| 200 | `project-agents` | `<projectRoot>/.agents/skills` |
| 300 | `custom` | `Config.customSkillDirs` |
| 400 | `user-dsh` | `<dshHome>/skills` |
| 500 | `user-agents` | `<agentsHome>/skills` |

The project root is the nearest ancestor containing `.git`; without one, the current cwd is used. The user DSH root skips its `.system` child. `includeDefaultRoots: false` omits the project and user rows plus the `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` default so an isolated provider sees only its own configured roots; `bundledSkillDir` adds a bundled root at rank 600.
### Mount and configure
Load the plugin alongside the skill registry; it requires `ctx.skills`.
```yaml
- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill'
- name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `providerName` | `filesystem` | Unique provider name registered on `ctx.skills` |
| `includeDefaultRoots` | `true` | Include project and user roots around `customSkillDirs` |
| `dshHome` | `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh` | Harness config root; its `skills` subdirectory is scanned |
| `agentsHome` | `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` or `~/.agents` | Shared agent config root scanned for compatible skills |
| `customSkillDirs` | `[]` | Additional local skill roots, after project roots and before user roots |
| `watch` | `true` | Watch local roots and invalidate the provider when the catalog may have changed |
| `bundledSkillDir` | — | Bundled skill root scanned at rank 600 when configured |

The remaining `watch*` fields tune Chokidar behavior — polling, stability window, interval, project cap, and symlink following. The generated [configuration catalog](../../../docs/config-catalog.md#deepseek-aidsh-skill-filesystem) is the exhaustive source for every field.
### Change detection

Existing roots are watched, so adding, renaming, or deleting a skill (or editing its frontmatter) triggers a catalog refresh for the next model step; edits below `references`, `scripts`, `assets`, and other bundle resources do not. The first-party `write` and `edit` tools invalidate the provider directly when their target could affect a watched skill, so the model observes its own filesystem mutation without waiting for the host watcher. External IDE, Git, and shell changes are picked up by the host watcher, and a root that does not exist yet is probed until it appears.
### Observable success and failures

A valid skill under any scanned root appears in the session catalog sorted by name, and loading it returns the current file body. A file without valid frontmatter, an invalid name, or an invalid invocation value is skipped with a warning, so the model catalog receives no per-skill diagnostic and cannot distinguish an absent skill from an invalid one. A root whose discovery or file read fails is logged with its path and omitted; other roots remain available. The observation is incomplete and is retried on the next lookup rather than cached. The model catalog identifies incomplete discovery separately from confirmed absence.
## Understand the implementation
<details>
<summary>Implementation internals — click to expand</summary>
This section explains how discovery and watching are organized; the observable behavior is fully covered in [Use this package](#use-this-package).
### Design concept

The provider is built on two separations. First, catalog versus body: discovery parses frontmatter into summaries, while every load re-reads the file, so body edits need no hash, revision, or cache invalidation. Second, discovery versus watching: `list()` scans roots and resolves the project root through `ctx.fs` when a filesystem service is present (falling back to abortable Node I/O), while a separate watch manager owns Chokidar handles, missing-root probes, and invalidation.
### Source map
| File | Role |
| [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts) | Plugin entry, provider, root resolution, frontmatter parsing, watch manager |
### Discovery flow

Discovery resolves the root list for the lookup cwd, asks the watch manager to attach to each root, then scans each root's direct entries: directory bundles resolve `<name>/SKILL.md`, flat files resolve `<name>.md`. Each file is parsed for frontmatter — `name` must be kebab-case, `description` is required, and the invocation keys resolve through the strict boolean grammar — and candidates carry the root's source label and rank so the registry can merge them with other providers. Confirmed missing paths are valid empty state; malformed or non-text entries warn and skip.
### Watching and invalidation

Existing roots are watched by Chokidar at depth 1; a root that does not exist is followed from its nearest existing ancestor one missing segment at a time using `fs.watchFile`. Relevant events — direct bundle add/remove, flat `.md` add/remove, and direct `SKILL.md` add/remove/change — coalesce into one provider invalidation per microtask batch, while resource-subtree changes are ignored. The watch manager is bounded by `watchMaxProjects`, logs and retries failed startup, and closes every handle at teardown. First-party `write`/`edit` mutations invalidate synchronously through the `fs/observed` event.
</details>
## Further Exploration

Read these pages when the package-level contract is not enough. They move from the registry contract to the consumer that renders discovered skills and the home-path resolution used by the config defaults.
- [Skill subsystem reference](../../../docs/subsystems/skills.md) — the registry contract and the local discovery priority table.
- [skill package](../skill/README.md) — the registry this provider registers on.
- [tool-skill package](../tool-skill/README.md) — how discovered skills reach the session catalog and the model.
- [home-paths package](../../util/home-paths/README.md) — how `dshHome` and `agentsHome` resolve.
## Model Experience

Indirectly, through `dsh-tool-skill`, which renders this provider's invocable names and capped descriptions into the initial or replacement catalog and a selected current instruction body plus resource-base guidance into retained tool history while paths, provider ranks, and disabled skills remain hidden.
#### KV Cache effect
Watcher invalidation can cause the named consumer to append a replacement catalog to the existing request history. Body-only edits leave the catalog digest unchanged.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
These limits define when the provider is a poor fit or needs special operational care. They are current package constraints, not a task backlog.
- **Discovery is one level deep** — only `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` and `<root>/<name>.md` are recognized; nested skill trees and package manifests are ignored.
- **Project scope is the nearest `.git` ancestor** — workspaces without that marker fall back to the supplied cwd, with no alternate project-root marker or monorepo subproject selection.
- **Malformed entries disappear with a warning** — the model catalog receives no per-skill diagnostic and cannot distinguish an absent skill from an invalid one.

- **I/O failures omit the whole root** — one unreadable skill also hides its readable siblings for that observation. Other roots remain available, so a lower-priority same-name skill can supply the description and loaded body. Discovery retries on each lookup and restores normal priority when the root recovers.

- **Missing-root observation polls one path segment** — roots absent at startup use `fs.watchFile` at `watchPollIntervalMs` until Chokidar can attach, trading bounded detection latency for reliable creation detection across IDE, Git, and shell workflows.
- **No body revision protocol** — a loaded body is ordinary retained tool history; later file edits affect later calls but neither rewrite old results nor announce that the body changed.
### Dev Note
<details>
<summary>Working context for maintainers — click to expand</summary>

This Dev Note is working context for maintainers and is explicitly non-authoritative — shipped behavior and limits live in the sections above and in the code. A TODO in `src/index.ts` proposes extracting the Chokidar and missing-root observation into a Cordis file-watch service, keeping skill filtering and invalidation here; the missing-root polling tradeoff documented above is part of that open design.
</details>

description: A股景气投资体系 V2.2（唯一有效完整版）与“6成中长线+4成波段”双账本仓位实战框架。凡涉及A股个股深度分析、赛道景气评分、期权估值、预期差反推、E/L/M阶段判定、P0-P4价格推演或买卖仓位决策时，必须先加载本技能。
